# Private adaptive SOURCE gate — not recommended for promotion

The unchanged actual C20 still requests C26 SOURCE_BEGIN3. This private C26
profile, `SE_EDITOR_CACHED_INLINE_SOURCE=1`, checks owner before phase access,
then reads the saved continuation flag, source-controller flags, cache flags,
queue, count/role/kind, actual inline hint and unsigned24-bit END-BODY. Only an
eligible body of at least512 bytes delegates REQUEST39/OP0/A1 before any phase
clear, lease or parser call. These are admission hints, not cached authority:
C39 still checks the full source59/AUTH13/typed graph/CRC/schema contract.

Explicit SOURCE_FALLBACK5 enters the unchanged legacy SOURCE path without
re-delegation. C39 miss first ends its owned reader, then requests26/5/A1; C39
success requests20/1/A1 after END. Normal C26 APIs are unchanged. With the flag
absent, the modified C26 source reassembles byte-identically to the packaged
3327-byte control. Enabled C26 is3436 bytes; C39 remains4088. No new BSS/ZP,
object, bank, resident code or main build is introduced. C39 is unregistered.

`build.py` constructs both actual C26 images from the immutable product-source
archive and checks control/default byte identity. `gate.inc` is the sole new
admission body, and `adaptive-api.inc` exposes opcode5 only in the optional
profile. `entry.s` differs from the separately released SOURCE adapter only in
the C39 miss operand3→5. Existing released component/adapter sources are untouched.

Run `python3 tests/test_cache_inline_adaptive.py`. The test follows actual
REQUEST/OP among actual C20/C26/C39, verifies independent style-aware geometry
and every map boundary, backup lifetime, pending data, revoked proof, malformed
certificate fallback without a loop and source-change rejection. It checks all
16MiB and canonical/history/shim bytes. The exact gate include also has64
full64KiB predicate cases, including 24-bit subtraction/overflow/underflow,
COUNT0, owner opacity, flags/queue/controller/role/count refusal and opcode5
bypass. The same C39 body passes the independent34-window/11-fault component
suite, including all colors/styles/hidden masks, typed-write revocation and
foreign leases. This is a manual sequential frontend, not resident/native proof.

## Actual performance decision

Length-only admission is **insufficient and must not be promoted as-is**.
Tiny inline rows never load39 and retain the same DMA/load counts (about1%
extra instructions from the larger C26/check). A998B wrapped body improves
about23% (362192→278k; loads3→4), and an actual66004B body/query65900 improves
11990156→257040 instructions, with2038→14 DMA calls. However a dense1800B body
with300 `**x**` pairs regresses1037501→6418974 instructions and32→338 DMA calls.
C39's complete checked event traversal dominates. The next admission must use
actual authenticated event count/work, not BODY length alone. No broad cache
speedup or native latency claim is made.
